name: countermovement jump arms on hip
description: A vertical jump with hands on your hips so the legs do all the work. It develops explosive leg power.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat.
Explode upward, extending hips, knees and ankles.
Reach for maximum height without using your arms.
Land softly on bent knees and reset.
